title: Remove the 17 below-the-fold image preloads and re-test LCP
description: Audit the home page for image preloads and record the current count and which images are preloaded. Remove the preload and priority attributes from every image that is below the fold, keeping priority only on the actual LCP image. Deliver the exact code diff, the before and after preload count, and a local Lighthouse mobile run for the home page with the LCP before and after. Do not claim a field-data improvement from a lab run. If the repo state does not match the live page, say so and use the live page as the source of truth.

goal.title: Pass Core Web Vitals on zedu.chat marketing pages by Fri 4 Dec
goal.description: Measure LCP, INP and CLS on the home, pricing and product pages with PageSpeed Insights, list the causes (images, scripts, fonts) and give fixes with the zedu-fe file for each. Done when: every marketing page passes Core Web Vitals on mobile in a re-test by Fri 4 Dec.

workstream.title: Remove the 17 below-the-fold image preloads on the home page, then re-test LCP
workstream.description: The live home page preloads 18 images at once: one hero and 17 below the fold. That competes for bandwidth during first paint and works against LCP on mobile, especially on slower networks. Keep priority on the hero only, lazy-load the rest with explicit dimensions, and record a before/after PageSpeed mobile run so the change is measurable.
